name: Seasonal Christmas Decor
summary: A 2.5 m star-topped Christmas tree, four wrapped gifts and two hanging snowflakes in three shared colours.
description: Original low-cost seasonal mall set with seven evergreen branch skirts, 27 plain red and gold baubles, one faceted star, four ribbon-wrapped gift boxes and two suspended six-arm snowflakes. Static decorative geometry; no brands, text, external assets or switching runtime.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / Codex-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and solid-colour materials; no random inputs or external assets.

display.origin: floor centre of complete set bounds

accuracy_notes: Static seasonal decoration. Hanging cords end at source attachment anchors; the consuming scene supplies ceiling mounts and theme-switching logic. No animated switching, collision, physical phone or WebKit verification. Full 17-shop mall performance is not measured.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry and materials created with Codex assistance. No third-party assets, images, fonts or brands.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.

reuse_assessment.decision: new original asset under owner override
reuse_assessment.reason: Neither existing asset provides the complete tree / four-gift / two-snowflake set under the three-material and triangle budgets.
